preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some MiniDOGE tokens to initiate the attack
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default is false, but owner may enable it)
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens (minimumTokensBeforeSwap = 200000 * 10**6 * 10**9) from fees to trigger swap

exploit_hint: Deploy a malicious contract that implements a reentrancy attack in its fallback/receive function. The attack exploits the swapTokensForEth function which uses swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with a callback to the contract. When the contract sells tokens to the pair, it triggers the swapAndLiquify logic if conditions are met. The malicious contract should: 1. Hold MiniDOGE tokens, 2. Call transfer/sell function to trigger swapTokens, 3. In the receive() function (called when BNB is sent), re-enter the contract by calling another function that transfers value before state updates are complete, 4. Drain BNB from the contract before the inSwapAndLiquify flag is reset.
